_meta.status_legend: PLANNED = drafted, not yet ratified/verified. equation_gated = chain link needs a primary-source equation transcribed (NLM / bible) before its paragraph prose can be written.

relation_legend.CALLBACK: 2.1 ALREADY established this (paper, concept, or claim). 2.2-2.5 must REFERENCE it in one clause, NOT re-review it. Prevents redundancy with the complete 2.1 lit review.
relation_legend.FORMALIZES: 2.1 developed the idea conceptually; this subsection turns it into a formal, testable object (hypothesis direction, equation, estimand). New precision, not new concept.
relation_legend.NEW: Genuinely new content 2.1 does not contain -- the real load-bearing work of this subsection.

_meta.governing: Thin-claim ceiling binds every link. 'Do not batch' still governs the later verify+write loop (one paragraph at a time); this PHASE-1 batch is planning skeleton only.

what_2_1_already_does: P1: disclosure-state lens; MNPI; may-stay-silent-but-not-mislead (basic1988/rule10b5); withholding bind; descriptive/correlational register stated up front.

P2: venue = earnings call (scripted presentation + unscripted Q&A); ADOPTS the LM uncertainty dictionary (285 words, imprecision not risk) + the presentation/Q&A split. (matsumoto2011, lm2011 introduced here.)

P3: develops the FIRST dimension -- ANTICIPATORY: uncertainty language elevated while undisclosed, recedes at announcement; 'a directional prediction we test rather than assume.' (hollander2010 introduced.)

P4: locates the anticipatory signal in the CALL-VARYING RESIDUAL, not persistent CEO style; 'only the research design that follows can isolate' it. (bertrand_schoar2003, dwz introduced; DWZ decomposition stated conceptually, NO equation.)

P5: develops the SECOND dimension -- CASH-CONCENTRATED: cash draws on accumulated position (harford1999, framed as by-product of retained FCF, NOT saving-to-fund); stock = placebo; states the TWO CLOCKS (uncertainty resolves at announcement; cash persists to completion).

P6: positions vs nearest neighbors (thewissen2024 tone +15%; ragozzino2024 strategy vocab; keown1981 prices move ahead, 'prices not language'); novelty claim 'to our knowledge no prior work reads this.'
P7: two readings (compliance-constrained vs strategic silence) observationally equivalent; design cannot distinguish; correlational pattern, NO mechanism, NO identification, NO intent.
cross_cutting_rules_derived: RULE-COH-1 (no re-review): 2.1 is the COMPLETE lit review. Any paper introduced in 2.1 (matsumoto2011, lm2011, hollander2010, bertrand_schoar2003, dwz, harford1999, thewissen2024, ragozzino2024, keown1981) is a CALLBACK downstream -- reference in a clause, never re-survey.
RULE-COH-2 (bounded register everywhere): every downstream prediction/design honors P7 -- predicts a PATTERN, never asserts a cause, intent, or identification.

RULE-COH-3 (no war-chest): the 2.4 cash equation and any cash framing honor P5 -- cash accumulation is a by-product of retained FCF, NOT purposive saving toward the deal. No empire-building/agency mechanism.

RULE-COH-4 (residual locating belongs to P4): 2.3 must NOT re-argue 'the signal lives in the residual' (P4 did it). 2.3 opens with a one-clause callback to P4, then does the NEW work: define eq-4 formally + own the two threats.

RULE-COH-5 (scrutiny is a confound, not a P7 reading): the analyst-scrutiny channel introduced in 2.2/2.5 is a separate CONFOUND ruled out empirically in 4.1 -- it is NOT one of P7's two observationally-equivalent readings, and ruling it out does NOT establish a mechanism (P7 stays open).
RULE-COH-6 (forward-ref hygiene): 2.2 states hypotheses about 'the residual' before 2.3 defines it; use a light forward-pointer to 2.3, do not define the measure inside 2.2.

2.2.title: Hypothesis Development
2.2.purpose: Convert the 2.1 framework into formal, falsifiable predictions about WHERE/WHEN the signal appears -- never WHY. Each hypothesis states a prediction (direction + where/when) and the prior empirical contrast that makes it non-obvious, leaning on contrasts 2.1 already set up.
2.2.serves: Falsifiable claims with stakes; the bridge to the designs (2.4 maps each design to a hypothesis).
2.2.boundary: Predictions only; do NOT define the measure (2.3) or estimator (2.4); never assert a cause.
2.2.thin_claim: H1a = concentration, not strict specificity; no hypothesis asserts a cause; the scrutiny alternative is a real competing hypothesis, not a strawman.
2.2.division_of_labor: 2.1 DEVELOPED both dimensions (P3 anticipatory, P5 cash + two clocks) and the contrasts (P6 thewissen/keown). 2.2 ADDS: formal falsifiable hypotheses (directions, treated sets, PreAnnounceQtr=1[e=-1]) + the scrutiny competing-hypothesis (NEW). It does NOT re-review the 2.1 papers.

subsection_prop_chain.do_not_repeat: P5 already develops cash-vs-stock + placebo + harford. Reference; state H1a as the formal differential prediction.

subsection_prop_chain.claim: A competing analyst-scrutiny reading (analysts ask harder cash questions, mechanically lifting uncertainty) is stated formally as the prediction 4.1 tests and rules out.
subsection_prop_chain.do_not_repeat: matsumoto2011 already cited in P2 -> CALLBACK. The scrutiny channel itself is NEW (2.1 does not raise it).
subsection_prop_chain.grounding: roadmap 2.2 Must-do 5; claim C4 (gating interaction -0.0056 n.s.).
subsection_prop_chain.register_note: RULE-COH-5: this is a CONFOUND to rule out, NOT one of P7's two equivalent readings; ruling it out does NOT establish our mechanism.

2.3.title: Estimation of the Main Variable
2.3.purpose: Define and JUSTIFY the dependent variable UncResCEO (the DWZ residual): the formal eq-4, what is netted out, and the two honest threats to it.
2.3.serves: Makes the core construct credible + reproducible; the DV every design uses.
2.3.boundary: Defines the MAIN var only (UncResCEO + inputs UncAnsCEO / UncPreCEO / CEO-FE / ClarityCEO). Other constructs -> 2.5/3.1. Construction MECHANICS (tokenize, match) -> 3.1.
2.3.thin_claim: Disclose generated-regressand + UncPre honestly; validity is an empirical question answered in 2.5, not assumed.
2.3.division_of_labor: 2.1 P4 ALREADY argued the signal must live in the call-varying residual (conceptually, no equation) and explicitly deferred isolation to 'the research design that follows.' 2.3 ADDS: the formal eq-4 + regressor set, and the two threats (UncPre over-control, generated-regressand) -- the real new work. It does NOT re-argue the locating logic (RULE-COH-4).
register_constraints: RULE-COH-4 (residual locating = one-clause callback to P4, not a re-argument)

2.5.title: Specification and Measurement of Key Constructs

2.5.thin_claim: Convergent = 'consistent with' (weak, disclosed); discriminant = decisive; scrutiny = 'doesn't account for THIS run-up,' not 'never matters.'
